description: One-paste 'tell me everything': auto-detects DNA/RNA/protein, then reports composition, ORFs, single-cutter enzymes, end primers or protein properties, plus a BLAST link.

circular.description: Treat the molecule as a circle when scanning enzyme sites, so one that cuts across the origin is counted. Off by default because this tool is as often handed a PCR product as a plasmid.

endPrimerLength.description: Length of the naive end primers taken from each end.

maxOrfs.description: Maximum number of ORFs to return, longest first.

minOrfAa.description: Minimum ORF length in amino acids (nucleotide input only).

sequence.description: Nucleotide or protein sequence (raw or FASTA; IUPAC accepted). The alphabet is detected.

name: characterize_sequence
title: Characterize sequence
